name: exam_statement
description: A candidate's statement of entry for an exam series, sent to the pupil and their contacts.
subject: Statement of entry: {pupil_name} - {series_name}
body: Below is {pupil_first_name}'s statement of entry for the {series_name} exams at {school_name}.
Please check the subjects, tiers and the name carefully. If anything is wrong, contact {officer_name} straight away - changes after the board's deadline cost extra and may not be possible.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.pupil_first_name: The pupil's preferred or first name
placeholders.statement: The candidate number, entries and access arrangements
